lý luận và lịch sử mỹ thuật ứng dụng: Theory and History of Applied Arts
kết nối lý luận, lịch sử mỹ thuật và thự: Connect theory, art history and design practice; develop critical thinking and research capacity to analyze, explain and clarify the value of applied arts in life.
thời gian đào tạo 24 tháng định hướng ng: Program duration 24 months The research track

chương trình thạc sĩ lý luận và lịch sử: The Master's program in Theory and History of Applied Arts at Van Lang aims to develop research, analysis and criticism capacity in the field of applied art and design. Students approach professional issues from the foundation of history, culture, aesthetics and interdisciplinary knowledge.
các học phần bắt buộc kết nối phương phá: Required modules connect scientific research methods, art historical research, creative methodology and design thinking. The specialized sector continues to deepen the theory of Vietnamese applied arts, history and industrial aesthetics, theoretical basis of the topic and thematic research.
các lựa chọn học phần mở rộng góc nhìn v: Module options broaden perspectives on visual culture, theory and criticism, community design, user experience, environment and sustainable design. Students accumulate elective credits according to the structure and academic plan of the Faculty.
văn bằng tốt nghiệp: thạc sĩ lý luận và: Degree awarded: Master of Applied Art Theory and History.
định hướng nghiên cứu. kết nối lý luận v: The research track. Connecting theory with design.
kết nối nghiên cứu lịch sử mỹ thuật, lịc: Connect the study of art history, design history and applied Vietnamese art theory with options in visual culture, art studies and criticism.
phát triển cách tiếp cận vấn đề qua phươ: Develop an approach to problems through scientific research methods, creative methodologies, design thinking and interdisciplinary knowledge.

chương trình hướng đến khả năng tự học,: The program aims at the ability to self-study, self-research and approach problems from many fields. Students practice critical thinking, information collection and analysis skills, and connect historical and cultural values with creative needs in practice.
chín chuẩn đầu ra tập trung vào kiến thứ: Nine learning outcomes focus on interdisciplinary knowledge, theory and criticism, creative thinking, research methods, professional communication and collaboration and community responsibility.

chương trình đào tạo theo định hướng nào: What orientation is the academic program and how long does it take?
chương trình thạc sĩ lý luận và lịch sử: The Master's program in Theory and History of Applied Arts is research-track, with a load of 60 credits and a standard duration of 24 months. Class schedules are arranged on weekday evenings and/or Saturdays and Sundays according to each semester's schedule. The official timetable is announced by the University.
nội dung nghiên cứu tập trung vào những: What areas does the research focus on?
chương trình kết nối lý luận, lịch sử và: The program connects applied art theory, history and criticism with research methods, design thinking and interdisciplinary knowledge. Elective modules extend to visual culture, community design, user experience, environment and sustainable design.
học viên tích lũy 8 tín chỉ tự chọn thuộ: Students complete 8 foundation elective credits and 9 specialist elective credits, totaling 17 credits. Foundation electives carry 2 or 3 credits each, while specialist electives carry 3 credits each. Selection and registration follow the Faculty's curriculum structure, guidance and academic plan.
ngành tốt nghiệp nào cần bổ sung kiến th: Which Previous Fields Require Bridging Courses?
ngành lý luận lịch sử và phê bình mỹ thu: Graduates in Art Theory, History and Criticism are exempt from bridging courses. Listed related fields are divided into groups requiring up to 4 or 10 bridging credits, determined from applications and transcripts. For fields not listed, the Faculty submits its assessment and recommendation to the University.
luận văn tốt nghiệp chiếm bao nhiêu tín: How many credits does a thesis take?
luận văn tốt nghiệp có khối lượng 15 tín: The thesis has a load of 15 credits and is part of the total 60 credits of the program. Students need to complete and defend their thesis satisfactorily and meet the graduation requirements of the program and the University.
yêu cầu ngoại ngữ đầu vào và đầu ra như: What Are the Foreign Language Requirements for Admission and Graduation?
ứng viên đáp ứng ngoại ngữ đầu vào tương: Candidates must meet the foreign language entry requirements equivalent to Level 3/6 or higher according to the recognition forms in the admissions announcement. Before graduation, students need to meet foreign language graduation requirements equivalent to Level 4/6 or higher according to regulations.
học phí toàn khóa và cách đóng học phí r: What Is the Total Tuition Fee and How Is It Paid?
học phí toàn khóa là 100.000.000 đồng, c: Total program tuition is VND 100,000,000, divided into three installments: VND 35,000,000, VND 30,000,000 and VND 35,000,000. The amount shown is before scholarships and financial support and excludes any applicable additional fees. Payment deadlines will be specifically announced by the University.
